name: Kids Psychology Role-Play Centre (mini city + child psychology clinic)
tags: kids psychology, play therapy, role-play city, KidZania-inspired, OT / sensory gym, observation rooms, calm rooms, Class 9b, Rev C
description:
A mini city where kids go to work, with a child psychology clinic built in (inspired by KidZania Japan). Children aged about 4–12 [TBC] check in at an 'airport', get a work passport and starting play money, choose real-world jobs along a child-scale Main Street (firefighter, mechanic, cook, builder, vet, shop worker), work a 20–30 minute shift, get paid, then bank or spend. Wrapped around the play is a calm, clinically fitted psychology wing: play-therapy rooms with one-way observation, a group room and an OT / sensory gym. Not a theme park: warm timber, soft sage, sand and muted colours, quiet acoustics and predictable wayfinding to support regulation. Designed for an assumed 40 x 25 m (c. 1,000 m²) tenancy with a single shopfront to the precinct mall.

KEY DESIGN MOVES
- Two front doors on the mall: the kids' controlled entry / exit (via Arrival, wristband matching at the kids' gates) and a separate clinic entry with a calm, private arrival. A staff-controlled link door joins Arrival and the clinic.
- One loop, one hub: a single one-way 3 m Main Street loops (clockwise) around a central glazed Parent Lounge + Bank / Job Board island; from the middle, parents and staff see every establishment front.
- Noisy west, quiet east: Fire Station and Mechanics Workshop (active, loud) on the west wall; Calm Rooms on the east next to the clinic; the clinic wing behind a full-height acoustic wall.
- Spend zone at the exit: the Shop / Mini Supermarket fronts the street near the exit.
- Wet play near the shopfront: the Fire Station water facade in the shopfront corner as a 'shop window' behind a glazed splash screen; suit-up room beside it.
- Clinic wing: reception + family waiting at its own entry, 1.8 m clinic corridor, play-therapy rooms paired around shared one-way observation rooms, group therapy / social skills room and OT / sensory gym.
- Amenities and back of house along the rear wall: kids' WCs + ambulant, accessible WC + baby change, staff room, cleaner, store; rear exits [TBC].
- Child safeguarding: sightlines into every establishment from the street, vision panels to Calm Rooms and staff areas, no hidden corners, single kids' exit.

COMPLIANCE FLAGS
Play centre likely Class 9b (assembly); clinic Class 5 (or 9a) — certifier to confirm egress, exits and sprinklers. Fire Station water play: recirculating, treated, drained, Legionella risk plan, AS 3740 waterproofing, P4/P5 slip resistance — hydraulic engineer and landlord consent. Cooking: induction / demo only [TBC]; exhaust per AS 1668 if commercial; food licence if selling. Therapy and observation rooms Rw 45+ min (Rw 50+ to the play hall), walls to slab. Mechanical to AS 1668.2 for high-occupancy areas. Blue Card and Child Safe Organisation obligations for the operator.
finishes: Warm timber (batten ceilings, arched child-scale facades), soft sage, sand, muted aqua, pale yellow, dusty pink and earthy tans; natural surfaces (wood, wool); warm, diffused, user-controllable lighting; acoustic panels, soft furnishings and acoustic vinyl to cut noise; static pictogram wayfinding and 'now / next' timers; rubber floor in the workshop; slip-resistant P4/P5 floor and glazed splash screen at the Fire Station; one-way observation glazing with curtains in the clinic.
